meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: How this campaign website collects and uses personal data under the Data Protection Act, 2019.

title: Privacy notice
lead: How we handle the details you give us on this website, under Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The data controller is [[TO CONFIRM: campaign committee legal name and registration with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner]]. Contact: [[TO CONFIRM: data protection contact email]].

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Only what you type into our forms: your name, phone number, constituency, optionally your email, and any message you write. We do not use tracking cookies. A small setting remembers your language and Lite mode on your own device.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.body: To record your pledge or volunteer offer, to reply to your message, and to update you about the campaign. We do not sell your data.

basis.title: Our legal basis
basis.body: Your consent, given by ticking the box on each form. You can withdraw it at any time.

share.title: Who sees it
share.body: Campaign staff and the service providers that deliver our email or store submissions on our behalf. We do not share your details with anyone else unless the law requires it.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: [[TO CONFIRM: retention period]]. We delete submissions when they are no longer needed for the purpose you gave them.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may ask to see, correct or delete your data, object to its use, and withdraw consent. You can also complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner.

security.title: Keeping it safe
security.body: Forms are sent over HTTPS, include spam protection, and are accessible only to authorised campaign staff.
